1.title: Three dead and several injured in shooting at food festival near Seattle's Space Needle
1.summary: Police say two suspects were shooting at each other and one of them is in custody and one at large.

2.title: Netanyahu accuses NYC Mayor Mamdani of 'fomenting hate' after arrest threat
2.summary: Mamdani walked back his threat last week, acknowledging he lacked the legal power to arrest Netanyahu on a warrant issued by the International Criminal Court.

3.title: Musk takes 'crusade' to Europe with Armie Hammer film
3.summary: Musk has backed a film called Citizen Vigilante featuring an American vigilante tearing across an unnamed European country.

6.title: Berlin Pride Attack Suspect Tried to Join ISIS, Prosecutors Say
